title: bardolier status output
description: The app's primary contract. cli-spec.md §7. Once the app ships (Phase 5+), changes to this schema are ADDITIVE ONLY.

root.description: The default root's path (roots[0]). Present and reportable even when mounted is false. See the top-level `roots` array for every configured root (phase 18).

roots.description: Every configured root's readable state. Additive since phase 18.

last_indexed.description: Additive since phase 27. Null while mounted (reconciled on every status call) or never indexed.

dir.description: The project's directory under its root. Reported rather than composed so the app can reveal it in Finder without knowing the layout (§3). bardolier's own files sit here; work/ data/ local/ home/ sit under it (§4.2).

state.description: partial = some but not all of the project's containers are up.

dev_container.description: Container name, or null when the project is stopped.

app_port.description: Host port the archetype's dev server is published on (cli-spec.md §9), or null when this project publishes none. Additive since Phase 9.

app_url.description: Ready-to-open URL for app_port, or null when there is no dev-server port. Reported rather than composed by the caller, for the same reason connection_hint is.

extra_ports.description: Extra ports declared on this project (cli-spec.md §5.1), sorted by name. Additive since Phase 12.

root.description: The configured root's name this project lives under. Additive since phase 18.

work_dir.description: <dir>/work — where repositories live and the dev container works (§4.2). Reported for the same reason dir is: the app must never compose a path. Additive since phase 19.

attached_extra_port.description: A declared extra port: the manifest's host port plus the caller's own name. cli-spec.md §5.1, §6 (Ports). Duplicated verbatim across status/port-add/port-remove/port-list; test/contracts.test.ts asserts the copies stay identical.

host_port.description: Debugging tap on the Mac. NOT what the dev app connects to.

container_port.description: Fixed port on the internal Docker network — what the dev app connects to.

name.description: A Docker volume name, or <project>/<key> for a data directory.

kind.description: What reclaiming this destroys: a Docker named volume, or a project's leftover data directory (phase 19). Absent means volume.

path.description: Host path of a directory orphan; null for a named volume. Additive since phase 19.

last_project.description: Owning project — the volume's bardolier.project label, or the project the data directory sits in — or null when it can't be attributed.
